{{Locations|Engi Controlled Sector|Engi Homeworlds|Mantis Controlled Sector|Mantis Homeworlds|LRSmap=noship|unique=true}}


''You arrive just in time to see an unusually well-armed Engi ship destroying a small pirate craft. A teleporter signal is detected...intruder on deck!''
*''A young Mantis in a charred uniform has teleported onto the deck. He begs for sanctuary from the Engi, and offers to serve in exchange for your protection. The Engi have already traced the teleporter signal and are offering a deal in exchange for the prisoner.''
*# Side with the fugitive and fight the Engi ship.
*#*''It was a trap! The Mantis sabotages your ship before teleporting away.''
*#** Your ship takes <span style="color:red">5 hull</span> damage, 1 damage to a random <span style="color:red">system</span>, 1 damage to a random <span style="color:red">room</span>, and you fight a mantis-controlled [[Engi Ships|Engi ship]] ([[Rewards#Default_rewards|default rewards]]). <ref name="Enemy ship (ENGI_MANTIS_CONTROLLED)">{{SurrenderEscape(alt)|no|ENGI_MANTIS_CONTROLLED|events_ships.xml}}</ref>
*#* ''He expresses his thanks and prepares to help you fight his pursuer.''
*#** You receive a <span style="color:limegreen">Mantis crewmember</span>, and you fight an [[Engi Ships|Engi ship]] ([[Rewards#Default_rewards|default rewards]]). <ref name="Enemy ship (ENGI_SHIP)">{{SurrenderEscape(alt)|no|ENGI_SHIP|events_ships.xml}}</ref>
*# Agree to offer up the Mantis in exchange for a bounty.
*#*''The Engi captain is delighted, and quickly arranges for the transfer of the prisoner.''
*#** You receive high [[Rewards#Scrap_only|scrap]].
*#* ''Fury sparks in the eyes of the Mantis. He won't go easily, and causes serious damage before he can be captured.''
*#** Your ship takes <span style="color:red">5 hull</span> damage, 1 damage with [[File:S_fire2.png|28px|bottom|1-2 fires|alt=fire]] to a random <span style="color:red">room</span>, and you receive high [[Rewards#Scrap_only|scrap]].
*#* ''The pursuing ship responds with a completely unintelligible message. The young Mantis jerks to attention and assumes a battle stance. It was a trap!''
*#** <span style="color:red">1 mantis boarder</span> beams aboard your ship, and you fight a mantis-controlled [[Engi Ships|Engi ship]] ([[Rewards#Default_rewards|default rewards]]). <ref name="Enemy ship (ENGI_MANTIS_CONTROLLED)" />

==Notes==
This event is called "ALISON_MANTIS_CREW" in the datafiles.
